title: Vijay Pande (a16z General Partner) on Incorruptible — 'I pick it up and go to a random page and it takes me to The Todd Park rule. Nicely done.'
summary: Vijay Pande — Andreessen Horowitz general partner and founder of a16z's bio + health fund — opens Incorruptible to a random page and lands on The Todd Park rule, the kind of specific design pattern that survives the random-page test.
blockquote: Started reading @ericries new book Incorruptible. I pick it up and go to a random page and it takes me to The Todd Park rule. Nicely done.
